spot.html_text: In recent work, Healey has also taken what he came to call a “desert pragmatist” approach to quantum theory (DP). He developed his (2012a) presentation in several papers now reprinted in Healey (2026a), and published an introduction to quantum mechanics following this approach in Healey (2017b). Healey (2026b) is a brief recent restatement of DP. He contrasts this with interpretations that attempt to say what the world would (or could) be like if quantum theory were true of it. On his approach q
